==LFA 174: Jones vs. Gennrich==
{{Infobox MMA event
| name= LFA 174: Jones vs. Gennrich
| promotion= Legacy Fighting Alliance
| date= January 12, 2024
| venue= [[Mystic Lake Casino Hotel]]
| city= [[Prior Lake, Minnesota]], United States
}}

'''''LFA 174: Jones vs. Gennrich''''' was a mixed martial arts event promoted by [[Legacy Fighting Alliance]] and took place on January 12, 2024, at [[Mystic Lake Casino Hotel]] in [[Prior Lake, Minnesota]], United States. It aired on [[UFC Fight Pass]].

===Background===

A [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#LFA Lightweight Championship|LFA Lightweight Championship]] bout between reigning champion JaCobi Jones and challenger Kegan Gennrich headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fightbookmma.com/lfa-174-jones-vs-gennrich-is-set-for-january-12/|title=LFA 174: Jones vs. Gennrich is set for January 12|website=FightBook MMA|access-date=2023-12-06}}</ref>  At the weigh-ins, Jones weighed in at 155.2 pounds, 0.2 pounds over the title limit. As a result, upon commencement of the fight, Jones was stripped of the title and only Gennrich was eligible to win it.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.fightbookmma.com/lfa-174-weigh-in-results-jones-vs-gennrich/|title=LFA 174 weigh-in results – Jones vs. Gennrich|website=FightBook MMA|access-date=2024-01-11}}</ref>

A 140-pound catchweight bout between Quang Le and Cody Peterson served as the co-main event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmaplanet.jp/161785|title=【LFA174】カンでも、タンでもない。キャリア7連勝を目指すクァン・リーは淡泊なサブミッション戦士|website=mmaplanet.jp|access-date=2024-01-13}}</ref>

'''''LFA 188: Sweeney vs. do Nascimento''''' was a mixed martial arts event promoted by [[Legacy Fighting Alliance]] and that took place on July 12, 2024, at the Wild Horse Pass Casino in [[Chandler, Arizona]], United States. It aired on [[UFC Fight Pass]].

=== Background ===
A [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#LFA Bantamweight Championship|LFA Bantamweight Championship]] bout between then champion John Sweeney and Rafael do Nascimento is expected to headline the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-05-21 |title=LFA brings the Bantamweight Championship to the Valley of the Sun at LFA 188 |url=https://www.lfa.com/lfa-brings-the-bantamweight-championship-to-the-valley-of-the-sun-at-lfa-188/ |access-date=2024-06-23 |website=Legacy Fighting Alliance |language=en-US}}</ref> At the weigh-ins, Sweeney came in at 141.4 lb, 6.4 pounds over the bantamweight limit for a title fight. As a result, Sweeney was stripped of the title and only do Nascimento was eligible to win it.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-07-11 |title=LFA 188: Weigh-in Results |url=https://www.lfa.com/lfa-188-weigh-in-results/ |access-date=2024-07-13 |website=Legacy Fighting Alliance |language=en-US}}</ref>

'''''LFA 197: Kuziutina vs. Guimarães''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event promoted by [[Legacy Fighting Alliance]] and that took place on November 22, 2024, at the Ginásio do Povilho in [[Cajamar, São Paulo|Cajamar]], Brazil. It aired on [[UFC Fight Pass]].

===Background===
An interim [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#LFA Women's Strawweight Championship|LFA Women's Strawweight Championship]] bout between interim champion (also [[Judo at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Women's 52 kg|2016 Olympic bronze medalist in judo]]) [[Natalia Kuziutina]] and Yasmin Guimarães headlined the event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-10-16 |title=LFA 197 Fight Card: Kuziutina vs. Guimarães – A Breathtaking Championship Showdown 
|url=https://www.fightbookmma.com/lfa-197-fight-card-kuziutina-vs-guimaraes-a-breathtaking-championship-showdown/ |access-date=2024-10-30 |website=FightBook MMA |language=en-US}}</ref>

== LFA 198: Miranda vs. Oyarzún ==
{{Infobox MMA event
| name= LFA 198: Miranda vs. Oyarzún
| promotion= Legacy Fighting Alliance
| date= December 6, 2024
| venue= Commerce Casino & Hotel
| city= [[Commerce, California]], United States 
}}

'''''LFA 198: Miranda vs. Oyarzún''''' was a [[mixed martial arts]] event promoted by [[Legacy Fighting Alliance]] and that took place on December 6, 2024, at the Commerce Casino & Hotel in [[Commerce, California]], United States. It aired on [[UFC Fight Pass]].

===Background===
The event were expected to headline by a [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#LFA Featherweight Championship|LFA Featherweight Championship]] title unification bout between current champion Elijah Johns and interim champion Lerryan Douglas and a [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#LFA Lightweight Championship|LFA Lightweight Championship]] bout between current champion Richie Lewis and Richie Miranda.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-10-22 |title=LFA 198 Fight Card – Johns vs. Douglas: A Championship Doubleheader 
|url=https://www.fightbookmma.com/lfa-198-fight-card-johns-vs-douglas-a-championship-doubleheader/ |access-date=2024-10-31 |website=FightBook MMA |language=en-US}}</ref> However, two title bout were removed from the event due to Johns illness and Lewis injury. As a results, Miranda complete the event against promotional newcomer Hugo Oyarzún in a new main event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-12-01 |title=Here Comes the Pain! Richie Miranda To Close Sensational 2024 at LFA 198 
|url=https://www.lfa.com/here-comes-the-pain-richie-miranda-to-close-sensational-2024-at-lfa-198/ |access-date=2024-12-07 |website=Legacy Fighting Alliance |language=en-US}}</ref>
